title: Paul arrives in Rome
summary: Paul arrives in Rome. Jones prints a two-year arrest.
description: Paul arrives in Rome. Jones prints a two-year arrest. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 61 AD (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.note: pending CFAH reference (the CFAH series does not cover this period; no tier 1–4 date exists)

chronologies.date: 4066 61 Paul’s 1st arrival in Rome: 2 yr. arrest
chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: CONFLICT: Jones prints AM 4066 and AD 61. Appendix F also prints AM 4004 as 1 AD. A derived check (not stored): 4066 minus 4003 = 63, which is not the printed AD 61. Both printed figures are stored as printed (first-printed rule). Neither was adjusted. The sort uses the printed AD year. Jones prints “2 yr. arrest”. No end year is stored.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 21st ed. (Master Books, 2019), Appendix F, printed p. 280
chronologies.note: 21st ed. (2019) differs; the 23rd ed. (2026) sets the sort: 4066 AM, AD 61.
